name: Xero Custom Connection
description: Xero Custom Connection is a premium machine-to-machine OAuth identity that uses client credentials to access exactly one subscribed Xero organisation.
agentUseSummary: This single-organisation accounting identity is visible as a canonical Xero extension preview. Relay will not collect Custom Connection secrets or create parallel tools beside the bounded canonical Xero reads.

capabilities.label: Use one Xero Custom Connection
capabilities.description: If this auth mode is approved, extend the canonical Xero connector with an exact single-organisation client-credentials binding while retaining only its three bounded read tools.

blocked.label: Create duplicate Xero provider state
blocked.description: A Custom Connection listing must not create parallel organisation tokens, tools or approvals beside Relay's canonical Xero connector.

blocked.label: Capture Xero Custom Connection credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not ask an operator to paste a Custom Connection client secret or access token into this Marketplace alias.

blocked.label: Administer a Xero Custom Connection
blocked.description: Purchasing subscriptions, creating apps, selecting scopes, naming authorising users, granting consent and changing the bound organisation remain provider-console workflows.

blocked.label: Expand Custom Connection accounting access
blocked.description: Financial writes, contacts, journals, bank data, payroll, reports and other scopes outside the canonical Xero connector's bounded reads are unavailable.

blocked.label: Run Xero actions from the setup alias
blocked.description: This alias exposes no runtime actions; approved support must extend the canonical connector with immutable organisation, client, scope and subscription binding.

approvalProfiles.label: Xero Custom Connection security review
approvalProfiles.description: This accounting identity alias is not connectable. Unattended client-credentials access remains unavailable until Relay can bind, encrypt, rotate, revoke and audit one least-privilege Custom Connection safely.

runtimeSupport.description: This alias installs no OpenClaw tools; approved Custom Connection support must extend the canonical Xero provider pack.
This alias installs no Hermes tools; approved Custom Connection support must extend the canonical Xero provider pack.

providerSetup.blocker: Xero Custom Connections are premium, region-limited machine-to-machine apps for exactly one organisation. Xero requires an organisation subscription, an authorising user, selected scopes, provider-hosted consent and a private client secret. Relay's canonical Xero connector currently supports customer-owned Web OAuth apps with rolling refresh tokens, not this unattended client-credentials mode.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep using the canonical Xero connector for bounded organisation and invoice reads. If Custom Connections are approved, extend that connector with immutable organisation/client/subscription binding; only accounting.settings.read and accounting.invoices.read; encrypted secret rotation and revocation; thirty-minute token renewal; scope and region checks; and the existing three redacted read tools. Never create parallel alias tools or expose financial writes.

evidence.supports: Xero defines Custom Connections as premium client-credentials integrations for one organisation and documents subscription, authorising-user, consent, client-secret and token steps.
Xero identifies Custom Connections as back-end machine-to-machine integrations with one connection, a monthly organisation fee, regional limits and no Marketplace eligibility.
Xero states Custom Connection access tokens expire after thirty minutes, require no refresh token or tenant header, and can be renewed from only the client ID and secret without user interaction.
Xero publishes granular accounting scopes; Relay's canonical connector deliberately retains only settings and invoice reads rather than broad accounting access.
